Where is Nobleton?

Nobleton is a community in the southwest of King Township, Ontario. This guide focuses on Nobleton, while linking to Township-wide resources where they serve local residents.

Nobleton on the Township website ↗

Where do I find municipal information?

King Township’s official website is the source for municipal services, notices and community information. Nobleton.ca is an independent community guide and does not provide municipal services.

Visit King Township ↗

Where can local businesses connect?

The King Chamber of Commerce serves businesses across the Township. Visit its website for current membership and event information.

Visit the King Chamber ↗
